response_args.floor_justification: Storm alert, price spike, and battery outage present heavy volatility signals; raising floor to 55% ahead of weather/grid stress.
response_args.reasoning: Position: shortfall. Dispatch-ladder step: battery discharge above floor. Golden rules binding: 1 (reliability), 2 (grid stability due to 2.0MW headroom), 4 (battery protection). Cascade: min_carbon (carbon, then cost, then renewables). Shortfall of 6.9MW is fully covered by battery_1 discharging 6.9MW (which is within its 10.0MW discharge limit and above the reserve floor), avoiding grid purchases entirely and thus emitting zero carbon. Market is held since grid import would add carbon and transmission headroom is tiny (2.0MW).
